dependentkink_____: Cyril "Hollow" Dependentkin arrived at R-F4 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam ruined the cap; the first puddle ruined the rest. The transfer made Cyril "Hollow" Dependentkin a runner. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself.

A round came through a gap in the sandbags at R-F4 and grazed Cyril "Hollow" Dependentkin's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Quentin Joshgentile of the Concord (@joshgentile80). Mail came up the line with a letter for Cyril "Hollow" Dependentkin. Cyril "Hollow" Dependentkin read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

The wound Cyril "Hollow" Dependentkin shrugged off has gone the wrong colour. He is not shrugging any more. Mail came up the line with a letter for Cyril "Hollow" Dependentkin. Cyril "Hollow" Dependentkin read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Hill 304 fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Cyril "Hollow" Dependentkin helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
Every bed was taken and every medic was busy. Cyril "Hollow" Dependentkin died waiting. The men at R-F4 have not stopped talking about it.

Dietrich Dependentkin came to the front because his cousin Cyril "Hollow" Dependentkin never came home. He carries a letter he never sent. Dietrich Dependentkin transferred to the runners. The men in R-F4 said they would miss him. He is only three dugouts away.

Someone had used a newspaper to wrap the onions. Dietrich Dependentkin read a theatre review while peeling supper. Mail came up the line with a letter for Dietrich Dependentkin. Dietrich Dependentkin read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
fwtx_p4y0n: Leopold Fwtx, a schoolteacher from Dunmarrow, was sent forward on Day 5 to fill a gap in S-F1. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.

Leopold Fwtx crawled out with the wiring party. When a flare went up, he lay still and counted to ten. The wire at S-F1 holds again. A letter from home found Leopold Fwtx before the night shift. Leopold Fwtx folded it small and kept it close. Word came down the line: Hill 304 is ours. Leopold Fwtx shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
Leopold Fwtx fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Quentin Underthrone, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything.
Leopold Fwtx watched fog gather on the wire until every strand carried beads of water. The sentry beside him called it expensive fencing.
rayan.zulfi: Pavel "Lucky" Zulfi signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at R-F9 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.

Someone had labelled the water bucket 'Soup'. Pavel "Lucky" Zulfi changed it back after lunch, too late to settle the argument. News of the loss of Verdel Ridge reached R-F9 with the rations. Pavel "Lucky" Zulfi ate while listening to the revised orders.

The barrage caught Pavel "Lucky" Zulfi in the open at R-F9. The medic tied two tourniquets and shouted for a bed. The shell that hit R-F9 took Pavel "Lucky" Zulfi with it. No stretcher, no surgeon, no last words. Just the crater.
Felix Zulfi had heard about Pavel "Lucky" Zulfi's courage. At R-F9, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.
Felix Zulfi was peppered by shell splinters at R-F9. A medic picked them out one by one while the next salvo came in.

Felix Zulfi no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt. The Hegemony took Hill 304, and the orders at R-F9 changed before the cheering ended. Felix Zulfi shouldered another load.
A bullet clipped Felix Zulfi's helmet at R-F9 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Jonas Steini of the Concord (@steini10.02).
The medics cleaned Felix Zulfi's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at R-F9.
steini10.02: Jonas Steini told the sergeant he was a medical student. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed more rain, and put him on sentry.

Jonas Steini raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-F7. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Benedikt Ngaihte of the Hegemony (@mng.ngaihte). Verdel Ridge fell to the Concord at dusk. Jonas Steini helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Jonas Steini is whole again, or near enough for the line.
Jonas Steini and Matthias Mart argued all night about whose hometown has the better beer. They agreed to finish the argument after the war.

Jonas Steini fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Leopold Shadowizard, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything. Hill 304 is in Hegemony hands. Jonas Steini stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
A clear shot from R-F7. Jonas Steini grazed Felix Zulfi and slid back down below the parapet.

Felix Serreno of the Hegemony threw a tin of tobacco into the Concord trench with a note: "for the one who sings". Jonas Steini kept the tin. A letter from home found Jonas Steini before the night shift. Jonas Steini folded it small and kept it close. Jonas Steini's transfer to the role of sniper was approved. The quartermaster wanted every borrowed item back before issuing anything else.
